versions.content: Process events according to their defined importance like pri- ority and/or severity Description: The events shall be sorted or assigned to a specific priority (e.g. Severity Mask - ISO14229-1 v.2013,Annex D3) representing their importance like: • Healed events can be overwritten; • Privileged storing in case of Event Buffer filled up with less privileged events. Rationale: ISO14229-1 v.2013 Use Case: Improved clustering and judging of events. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: ISO14229-1 v.2013
